full_judgment: 3. The petitioner as plaintiff filed Title Suit No.1 of 1996 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Chandina, Comilla, against the defendant opposite parties contending inter alia that one Abdur Rahim was the owner of the suit land and he was in possession for more than twelve years and the said Abdur Rahim on the basis of a registered deed of exchange dated 13.11.1984 exchanged with the plaintiff and the plaintiff got .30 acres of land and possession thereto and continued possession for more than twelve years and mutated his name in new Khatian No.489 in the said lands. The defendants have got no right title and possession in the suit land but threatened dispossession of the suit land on 29.12.1995 and as such the plaintiff filed Title Suit No.1 of 1996 for permanent injunction.
